What makes us Smiths?

Our purpose and culture

Smiths has been pioneering progress for 175 years, driven by our powerful culture founded on our values, innovation and excellence.

More Find out more

Innovation

Innovation is in our DNA. We invest 3-4% of revenue annually into research, development and engineering to develop new and differentiated products.

More Find out more

Talent

We are investing to build the skills and capabilities that will power future growth.

More Find out more

Our markets and strategy

We operate in four attractive markets – flow control, construction, thermal solutions and aerospace – where we have leading positions and differentiated proprietary technology and which are underpinned by powerful growth trends. Our growth strategy builds on these leading market positions. It is centred on four priorities – accelerate our growth initiatives, innovate with impact, execute relentlessly and compound value through M&A.

Our markets and strategy

Smiths Excellence

Smiths Excellence is how we solve problems and deliver results at Smiths. It is based on lean six sigma principles that drive operational excellence in support of our strategy. It empowers every colleague to challenge the status quo, become an innovator and solve problems at their root cause to unlock value. Across the entire organisation, Smiths Excellence is at the centre of how we work, blending tested approaches with practical learning and development to make us faster to market, more efficient and more sustainable.

Learn more

Our leadership

Our Board of Directors and Executive Committee work together to set and deliver Smiths goals and strategy and shape our culture. Together they are responsible for the long-term success of our company.
